import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
const systemCi = true;
test('base', { skip: !systemCi && 'needs systemd' }, (t) => { t.plan(1); t.assert.ok(true); });
test('the watchdog reads unit states from the real service manager', () => {
  if (!process.env.FIXTURE_NEVER) return;
  const r = spawnSync('systemctl', ['is-active', 'nonexistent-unit.service'], { encoding: 'utf8' });
  assert.fail(`the systemd assertions ran (${r.status})`);
});
